messages:
deploy-bot: :warning: Automated hold applied for release v1.8.3 -> PROD due to related incident INC-2028. Canary group 2/5 failing health checks. Hold reason: elevated error 502s from inference gateway.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2028 acknowledged by oncall. Root cause investigation in progress (probable NAT gateway throttle to east-us models).
samir: ack. can we pin traffic to v1.8.2 until we have a remediation plan?
tara: yes — recommend pin and a controlled rollback of canaries only. full rollback would be noisy for active customers.
olivia: +1 pin. also suggest delaying newsletter / release notes publish until we confirm stability.
mike: ops note: pinning to v1.8.2 is safe, but we need to drain KV caches on affected nodes after rollback: `./deployctl drain --cache kv --nodes canary-*`
jess: I can coordinate release notes delay and update the rollout tracker. tagging #marketing to hold publish.
samir: proposed timeline: 08:15 roll canaries back to v1.8.2, 08:25 run smoke-tests, 08:35 re-evaluate. if smoke OK, we can re-open canary at reduced rate.
tara: runbook step reminder: toggle `canary_quarantine=true` in the release config to stop new canary traffic while we act.
mike: executing pin now: `deployctl pin --service inference --version v1.8.2 --scope canary` (starting)
deploy-bot: Action queued: pin command received, owner=mike, op_id=op-3214.
mike: pin completed. will start drain now.
incident-bot: Note: a related alert was fired: `gw-502-spike` — engineering lead @samir is on it.
samir: running smoke tests now: `curl -sS -X POST https://smoke.internal/api/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}'`
(tests)
use: 1/3 smoke requests returned 200, 2/3 returned 502s — looks consistent with gateway throttling.
tara: ok we keep hold. ops to file a follow-up with infra to scale NAT/proxy and check kernel queue settings.
olivia: product: pushing back next-stage deploy to tomorrow change window 09:00-11:00 to give infra time. cc @sales for customers impacted.
jess: release notes publish postponed, will update changelog and post new date.
samir: next steps: infra to scale egress for east-us, rerun smoke tests, if success then unquarantine canaries at 10% and monitor 15m. if any regression, rollback full and open incident postmortem.
mike: creating a follow-up ticket: INFRA-5479 (scale nat, check proxy configs, KV drain validation).
deploy-bot: Hold remains in place until manual `deployctl release-unhold op_id=op-3214` is run by an owner.
jess: thanks all — I'll send a short status note to customers impacted and update the rollout tracker. :thumbsup:
